data.title: AfinLoans, an AI Lending Platform for the Self-Employed, Invited to Present at the U.S. House of Representatives
data.description: AfinClic Financial Technologies, Inc. (operating as AfinLoans) from Sunnyvale, California, has successfully secured $10 million in funding. Out of this amount, $4 million is being utilized to provide 1,000 loans to individuals who lack a credit history. The company is scheduled to present its unique methodology at the DCNY Summit on September 16th, held at the U.S. House of Representatives on Capitol Hill in Washington, D.C. Through cutting-edge AI technology, AfinLoans evaluates prospective borrowers without credit records by analyzing their income and the purpose of the loan. A recent trial run conducted in Salt Lake City demonstrated promising results, prompting further development and expansion.

data.title: Nicotine Pouches Canada Launches Pouch Club, Giving Every Customer 3% Cashback on Every Order
data.description: Based in Richmond, British Columbia, Nicotine Pouches Canada, the leading online retailer of nicotine pouches in the country, has introduced Pouch Club, a new cashback program for all customers. This initiative aims to reward loyal shoppers by offering 3% cashback on every paid order, which can be used as a spendable balance. The system operates on a simple principle: for each purchase made, 3% of the total amount spent on pouches is credited directly to the customer's account balance. This new opportunity provides customers with a tangible benefit for their ongoing support of the company.

data.title: X-Golf America Announces X-League: Fall Season, Where Bogey Golf Could Win You $10,000
data.description: The Fall Season of X-League is offering an indoor golf competition at 138 X-Golf locations across the country. This opportunity presents a lucrative reward for players achieving a bogey golf level.
